main.description: The frameless window draws its own titlebar; dragging it invokes the ACL-gated built-in start_dragging, which needs an explicit grant. A kendex:// link that arrives while the page is open reaches it as an event, and listening for one is ACL-gated too. Nothing else needs a grant: our own commands are plain app commands, and the dialog, opener, updater, deep-link and single-instance plugins are called through their Rust APIs, which never cross the ACL-gated IPC surface — granting their defaults would only open unused webview endpoints.
